verdict.rationale: Highnote docs explicitly support issuing virtual cards with spend rules configurable by MCC, dollar amount, and authorization count, plus velocity controls (e.g., weekly $1,000 limits) and per-workflow cards that auto-close when a task ends — directly matching one-purchase/one-merchant/exact-amount scoping. Collaborative authorization further allows real-time accept/decline logic enforced before funds move. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a strict 'single-use, exact amount, auto-expire after one transaction' card type or independent/hands-on confirmation that a single-use card is truly unusable after one authorization.
